topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I found out my child would have the same teacher I once did, a rush of memories flooded back. This wasn't just any teacher; it was the one who made science thrilling, who made us feel like the sky was the limit. Walking my kid to class on the first day, seeing that familiar smile, it felt like a thread of my past weaving into their future. As I watched them sit down, eager and curious, I couldn't help but feel a special kind of anticipation for the journey ahead. This teacher ignites a passion for learning, and now it's my child's turn to catch that spark.
